## Definition of done

Check every item. An item that does not apply is checked with "N/A" and the reason.

- [ ] The validated design is followed, or its change was validated; ADRs are written.
- [ ] Unit and integration tests are written and pass; the coverage threshold is met.
- [ ] Style, type, security and licence checks pass, locally and in CI.
- [ ] The glossary is up to date, and its terms are used everywhere.
- [ ] Translations exist in every language; those not reviewed by a native speaker are marked.
- [ ] Documentation (architecture, quick-start, how-to) is up to date.
- [ ] The `CHANGELOG` mentions the change, with its issue number.
- [ ] Plugin and development skills are up to date.
- [ ] Configuration example files contain every key.
- [ ] Records of processing, privacy policy and terms of use are up to date.
- [ ] SPDX headers and `CONTRIBUTORS.md` are up to date.
- [ ] Removed elements were deprecated first.
- [ ] No secret nor environment configuration file is committed.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (DCO).
